description: Situated in the residential area of Middlesbrough, Barsby Green offers a comfortable two-bedroom home ideal for tenants seeking convenience and practicality. The property features two well-proportioned bedrooms, a single living room, and a family bathroom. Its location within the TS3 postcode area ensures easy access to local amenities and transport links. Nearby, you will find Berwick Hills Primary School and Unity City Academy, both well-regarded educational institutions. For healthcare needs, the James Cook University Hospital is just a short drive away. The property is also close to Berwick Hills Centre, which offers a range of shops, supermarkets, and services. For outdoor enthusiasts, Pallister Park provides green open spaces for leisure and recreation. The area benefits from good public transport connections, including bus routes that link to Middlesbrough town centre and surrounding areas, making commuting straightforward.
